CustomField.description: Maximum number of automatic retries for a failed call. Set to 0 to disable retries. A Retry Backoff of 0 also disables them, except while the circuit breaker is open: then the retry waits for the breaker's cool-off.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum automatic retries for a failed call. Set to 0 to disable retries. A Retry Backoff of 0 also disables them, except while the circuit breaker is open: then the retry waits for its cool-off.
CustomField.label: Max Retry Count
